task: Cover the garden planner (`/`): four beds (Bed 1 watered yesterday, Bed 2 four days ago, Bed 3 three days ago, Bed 4 today); a bed needs water after three or more days. Water sets a bed's `Last watered` line to `today` and removes its Needs water badge, and the summary line (`2 beds need water`, or `No beds need water`) follows. Choosing a plant in a bed's Plant select changes that bed's plant. The Show only beds that need water filter hides the other beds and shows `All beds are watered` when no bed needs water. Watering and plant choices are stored on the server and survive a reload.
